input_binding_scope: JSON-only consistency and arithmetic checks. Recorded checkpoint/map hashes are cross-bound; archives and prepared arrays were not opened. Binary verification belongs to the completed source assessor.
limitations: Width and latent dimension change together; this package cannot separate their effects or show that an affine-rank restriction caused prior errors.
Equal26-epoch update budgets do not imply equal compute or selected-prefix budgets. Raw marginal checkpoint selection is retained and need not optimize calibrated dependence.
Fixed marginal maps impose margins/diversity and bounded tails; those are not independently learned joint evidence.
Battery outcomes are secondary for one hypothetical daily-reset device, not realized savings or annual/economic validity.
Repeated validation and prior failed screens remain part of selection history; this identity-curated internal source/year does not establish external validity.
No capacity44/55 extension is supported by the fixed pilot rule. All failed gates and both audit receipts remain visible.
